value.name: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
value.snippet: High throughput serving of large language models requires batching many requests.
value.summary: The paper introduces PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by virtual memory paging, and vLLM, a serving system built on it.
